Title: Application Insights is Available in South Africa North

Body.Content:
Azure Application Insights is now generally available in South Africa North

You can see the full list of available regions on the product web page.

Azure Application Insights is part of Azure Monitor. It collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Azure Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data.

Learn more about Azure Monitor and Application Insights in the documentation.
